description: The negative half of DAT-005b: a screen identity row whose id is not a canonical ULID and which carries no scope_node, and a device row with the same two defects, are both rejected — the identity rows are held to exactly the id grammar (DAT-005a) and the placement requirement (DAT-006) every other row this contract governs is held to, rather than to a weaker convention of their own. The screen's id here is the literal placeholder a pre-identity-row build shipped in its snapshot's screen_programs section, which is precisely the value DAT-005b makes unrepresentable.
